## What is the problem you're solving?

<!-- Frame this as "X is hard because Y". Vague problem statements
     (e.g. "export is slow") usually need more digging before we know
     which knob to turn -- a concretely observed workflow that's
     currently painful (e.g. "I can't tell which clip a spring
     entrance belongs to after I tweak it") is much more actionable. -->

## Desired UX

<!-- Walk us through it from the user's point of view. Mockups /
     screenshots / ASCII art all welcome. -->

## Acceptance criteria

<!-- Bullet list of what would constitute "this is done" -- e.g.
     * "The clip title in the Property Inspector becomes bold when
        the user is currently viewing that clip's preview frame."
     * "`npm run smoke:export` returns MP4 magic bytes within 60
        seconds on a cold cache on an M-series Mac." -->

## Alternatives considered (optional)

<!-- If you thought of another way to solve this and rejected it,
     share why. Skip this section if it would just say "nothing else
     came to mind". -->

## Out of scope / non-goals

<!-- Anything you specifically DON'T want this feature to do --
     prevents scope creep. -->
